This app made it easy to make reservations for my son’s wedding. Changes were easy to make. Our Host was very sweet. This is where the good things end. 

It was about 1:00 am on our second night. We had a very long and tiring day of celebration with my son and new daughter’s family. 

We were about ready to go to bed when we smelled something like some wires were hot or there was an electrical fire. We checked all the outlets and anything we could think and didn’t find anything so I texted our host. The app sent me to customer safety support. We were offered up to 3 rooms for up to 3 nights. This was a good offer we thought so we woke those who were sleeping and packed up. We ended up at 5:30 am -yes it took that long to get a reservations - having to drive an hour away for rooms that we couldn’t get into until 8:00 am. But they wouldn’t take our dogs so we drove another half an hour to another hotel who didn’t have any rooms available until 4:00 pm. 

This was Sunday, Mother’s Day, and we had 4 mothers, including myself. My mother is 81 and I was really looking forward to spending a Mother’s Day together with her, my daughter in law and my mother in law. My Mother’s Days together with my mom haven’t been many since I live 8 hours away from her and who knows how many I have left. This weekend was planned to be a nice relaxing day together. But we ended up leaving and just going home. We had only had short naps, since before the wedding the previous day. 

So my son’s wedding weekend and a special Mother’s Day weekend with my family turned into an absolute catastrophe because the customer service team is absolutely horrible. 

The only compensation we had for the rest of the missed stay and time together was $83. Yep. Airbnb doesn’t care about their customers. They are only in it for the money.
